costLines.description: Folded expense/cost lines for this project. Each line captures a single reimbursable cost (receipt, mileage, per-diem, material, …) previously held on the separate Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem objects. Source rows are migrated here by the FoldExpensesAndHoursIntoProject repair step (keyed by sourceId for idempotency).

costDate.description: Date the cost was incurred (ISO 8601 date).
costDate.title: Cost Date

type.description: Discriminator for the kind of cost line.
type.title: Type

amount.description: Monetary amount of the cost line in the line currency.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amount.
currency.title: Currency

costCentreCode.description: Cost centre / cost carrier code the line is allocated to.
costCentreCode.title: Cost Centre Code

sourceId.description: Stable id of the source object this line was folded from (Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem). Used as the idempotency key by the migration; do not reuse.
sourceId.title: Source ID

costLines.title: Cost Lines

hoursLines.description: Folded time-registration lines for this project. Each line captures a single hours booking previously held on a separate UrenRegistratie object. Source rows are migrated here by the FoldExpensesAndHoursIntoProject repair step (keyed by sourceId for idempotency).

date.description: Date the hours were worked (ISO 8601 date).
date.title: Date

personId.description: Identifier of the person who booked the hours.
personId.title: Person ID

recognisedRate.description: Rate at which the hours are recognised (revenue/cost rate).
recognisedRate.title: Recognised Rate

wbsoTagId.description: WBSO tag identifier classifying the hours for R&D tax purposes.
wbsoTagId.title: WBSO Tag ID

sourceId.description: Stable id of the source UrenRegistratie this line was folded from. Used as the idempotency key by the migration; do not reuse.
sourceId.title: Source ID

hoursLines.title: Hours Lines
